lines.speaker: Direction
lines.text: Hunters return to Eldara's guild town as evening settles. A small release light rises above the memorial street.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Back before the lamps go out?

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: It's a familiar route.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Familiar isn't safe.

lines.speaker: Garran
lines.text: Survey the known route. Take a team if you go deeper.

lines.speaker: Riven
lines.text: We could see the vault. Every step took us farther away.

lines.speaker: Liora
lines.text: Match the bell, arch and split rock.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: I'll find the route.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: The rifle runs on stored Echo Energy. Let the vents breathe. The Echo itself must go free.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: The Collector releases an Echo safely and stores the energy it yields. If the rifle overheats, use your blade until it cools.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: Understood. Energy is spent; the Echo isn't ammunition.

lines.speaker: Direction
lines.text: Sound drops away. Water climbs upward for a heartbeat. A violet fracture crosses the trail as foreign stonework appears in the distance.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: That wasn't here.

lines.speaker: Direction
lines.text: The way back is crushed. Aster's beacon receives no reply.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: The entrance is gone. Beacon's dead. I'll find another route.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: The Dawn team saw this before. There has to be a service route.

lines.speaker: Direction
lines.text: Three landmarks line up on the damaged field map: the Root Arch, the Hanging Bell and the Split Stone.

lines.speaker: Archive
lines.text: A projection identifies a Personal Continuity Device and an emergency passage beyond the sanctuary.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: The relic is real. And there's another way out.

lines.speaker: Recorded Researcher
lines.text: The structures aren't moving. The connections between them are changing.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: Verayan manufacture? How did it reach Eldara?

lines.speaker: Direction
lines.text: A damaged record briefly shows a parent comforting a child. The image fades before their faces resolve.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: A memory. Not a person.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: I was little when my parents died. The orphanage is most of what I remember.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: Supply, release, storage. The last one is already full.

lines.speaker: Direction
lines.text: The archive diagram shows a safe release line, a storage cell and a receiver. Their states can be read from their indicator lights.

lines.speaker: Archive
lines.text: Personal Continuity Device. Intended for rescue and research personnel.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: Just me. Everything else stayed.

lines.speaker: Direction
lines.text: The device restores Aster's recent position and personal condition. It cannot reverse the world, restore spent Echo Energy or undo weapon heat.

lines.speaker: Archive
lines.text: Convergence center… Nalora… release capacity exceeded…

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: This started somewhere else.

lines.speaker: Archive
lines.text: When both anchors lose agreement, isolate the passage. Do not force the connection.

lines.speaker: Archive
lines.text: Preserve the passage. Protect the living. Release the departed.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: I hear you. I'll keep them safe.

lines.speaker: Direction
lines.text: The gate begins to open, then shudders to a stop. Its remote anchor interface is fractured.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: Echo Rewind…

lines.speaker: Direction
lines.text: Aster rewinds himself. The gate remains broken. No replacement part is available, and the passage is unstable.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: No part. No stable passage. I can't fix this alone.

lines.speaker: Direction
lines.text: Aster routes reserve power to the diagnostic beacon. A low-power distress packet leaves the sanctuary; it cannot carry anyone through the fractured gate.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.text: I made it this far alone. Maybe that's as far as alone can take me.

lines.speaker: Direction
lines.text: Far away on Veraya, an anonymous terminal receives a signal. A hand reaches toward the screen.

lines.speaker: Terminal
lines.text: Survivor detected. Transit anchor failure. Assistance required.
